tools.name: jobs.list
tools.description: List jobs in your journey

tools.name: jobs.get
tools.description: Get details of a specific job

tools.name: jobs.add
tools.description: Add a new job to your journey

tools.name: jobs.update
tools.description: Update a job in your journey

tools.name: jobs.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a job and its application from the board. Confirm with the user first; it cannot be undone. To hide a job without recording a rejection or closure, use jobs.archive instead.

tools.name: jobs.refresh
tools.description: Queue a job posting to be re-scraped. The returned job may remain pending; use jobs.get later to inspect the refreshed state.

tools.name: jobs.mark_applied
tools.description: Mark a job as applied

tools.name: jobs.archive
tools.description: Hide a job from the active board without recording a rejection or closing the application

tools.name: jobs.unarchive
tools.description: Restore an archived job to the active board

tools.name: jobs.interviews.add
tools.description: Log an interview for a job

tools.name: jobs.interviews.update
tools.description: Update an existing interview

tools.name: jobs.interviews.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete an interview from a job. Confirm with the user first; it cannot be undone.

tools.name: jobs.offer.create
tools.description: Record a job offer with compensation details

tools.name: jobs.offer.update
tools.description: Update the offer recorded for a job

tools.name: jobs.offer.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete the offer recorded for a job (the job stays). Use only to fix a mistake, and confirm with the user first; it cannot be undone.

tools.name: jobs.offer.accept
tools.description: Accept the offer for a job. This is a major state change that closes out the search for this role; confirm with the user before calling. It does not email the employer.

tools.name: jobs.offer.decline
tools.description: Decline the offer for a job, a major state change; confirm with the user first. It does not email the employer.

tools.name: jobs.offer.add_negotiation
tools.description: Log a negotiation event on an offer (counter-offer, update, etc.)

tools.name: jobs.offer.delete_negotiation
tools.description: Remove a negotiation event from an offer

tools.name: following.list
tools.description: List all followed companies, their filters, state, and unread counts. Returns the full list without pagination. Following delivers future matching openings; use Search to browse jobs already in the index.

tools.name: following.follow
tools.description: Follow an indexed company for future matching openings and company recommendations. Get company_id from Search, a ready submission, or a recommendation candidate_company.id. Specify at least one match; [{}] follows all new openings. This does not submit an unknown careers page or collect historical

tools.name: following.update
tools.description: Replace all match filters for a followed company. Other follow settings are unchanged. Pass [{}] for all new openings. Pending means the new filters are being applied; old unread counts may change.

tools.name: following.unfollow
tools.description: Unfollow a company and remove its Following feed and recommendation source. Confirm with the user first. Board jobs remain. To pause temporarily instead, use following.pause.

tools.name: following.pause
tools.description: Pause future matching openings for this follow without deleting it. This does not stop shared company indexing or pause other follows.

tools.name: following.resume
tools.description: Resume a paused company follow.

tools.name: following.openings.list
tools.description: Read matching openings from followed companies. tab defaults to unread. Use the row id for marking read and nested opening.id for opening details or adding to the board. meta.unread_count/read_count cover the selected follow or all companies before view filters; meta.filtered_count covers the curren

tools.name: following.openings.mark_read
tools.description: Mark one Following row as read. Use the row id from following.openings.list, not nested opening.id.

tools.name: following.openings.mark_all_read
tools.description: Mark all unread openings as read for one follow, or every followed company if follow_id is omitted. Includes every page and openings hidden by view filters. Confirm the scope with the user first. The API returns no affected count; do not invent one.

tools.name: following.digest.get
tools.description: Read the user-wide Following email digest schedule. data is null if no schedule is configured. Company match filters are managed separately with following.update.

tools.name: following.digest.update
tools.description: Set the user-wide Following email digest schedule after the user requests it. Requires Plus or Student. For a new schedule supply frequency, hour (0–23), timezone (IANA), and weekday (Sunday=0) when weekly. Existing schedules can be patched.

tools.name: companies.submissions.create
tools.description: Submit a missing company using its public HTTPS careers URL, supplied or confirmed by the user. Refine detects supported sources and processes openings asynchronously. This adds to the shared index, not to Following. Use companies.submissions.get for progress; follow separately once company.id is av

tools.name: companies.submissions.get
tools.description: Read company submission progress. queued/detecting/processing means wait; ready means search again using the company name. unsupported means the careers source is not supported; failed means processing failed. Do not claim the company was added or invent jobs while it is still working.

tools.name: openings.get
tools.description: Read an indexed opening, including its full description and qualifications. Use opening.id from Search or Following, not a follow-opening row ID.

tools.name: openings.add_to_board
tools.description: Add an indexed opening to the board after the user chooses it. Uses opening.id, not the Following row ID. Returns the existing board job if already added. This does not apply to the employer or send email; it also marks any matching Following item as read.

tools.name: search.create
tools.description: Search indexed jobs or companies. Supply input OR query, not both. Natural-language searches return a search ID and processing state: use search.get later, without rapid polling. Keep the ID to paginate or update this same search. Empty query {} is All openings, currently sorted by newest without pe

tools.name: search.get
tools.description: Read a search and its results, switch jobs/companies view, or fetch results.next_page. Pending/interpreting/processing means it is still working: do not create another search or poll rapidly. If missing_company_name is set, ask for its careers URL and use companies.submissions.create. Company rows c

tools.name: search.update
tools.description: Update the existing search instead of creating another. Supply input OR the complete replacement query; omitted filters are cleared. Wait until the current search is ready or failed before updating it.

tools.name: search.company_openings
tools.description: Read all matching jobs for a company in a ready search, not just its three preview jobs. Continue with data.next_page until null. Use company.id from the search results.

tools.name: inbox.list
tools.description: List email conversations Refine matched to your job search (applications, interviews, recruiter outreach)

tools.name: inbox.get
tools.description: Get one inbox item with its related job and application

tools.name: inbox.get_thread
tools.description: Fetch the full email thread for an inbox item

tools.name: inbox.draft_reply
tools.description: Generate an AI reply draft for an inbox item. Returns HTML for review; it does not send anything.

tools.name: inbox.send_reply
tools.description: Send an email reply through the user's Gmail. This emails a real person from the user's address. Only call after the user has seen the exact message body and explicitly approved sending it.

tools.name: inbox.apply_suggestion
tools.description: Apply an inbox item's suggested action, such as adding an application to the board or recording a rejection. Confirm the specific action with the user first.

tools.name: inbox.undo
tools.description: Undo an auto-applied inbox action. This can delete a board record that the automatic action created, so confirm with the user first.

tools.name: inbox.mark_read
tools.description: Clear an inbox item's unread-reply flag

tools.name: inbox.unsubscribe
tools.description: Unsubscribe the user from this sender's mailing list via one-click list-unsubscribe. This changes the user's real email subscriptions; confirm with them before calling. Use it for unwanted bulk senders, not for a person you can simply decline.

tools.name: inbox.dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss inbox items you are not acting on (also marks the mail read in Gmail)

tools.name: inbox.acknowledge
tools.description: Keep auto-applied inbox items as-is and finalize the automatic action. Confirm the specific items with the user first.

tools.name: inbox.decline
tools.description: Queue decline replies to recruiter outreach. Depending on the user's preference this SENDS email from their address. Only call after the user explicitly approved declining these specific conversations.

tools.name: inbox.refresh
tools.description: Check Gmail for new mail now; returns per-account sync status

tools.name: inbox.sync_status
tools.description: Per-account Gmail synchronization status, including current progress and last sync time

tools.name: persona.get
tools.description: Get the user's persona: inferred job-search preferences and traits with an understanding score. Use it to tailor advice and searches.

tools.name: recommendations.list
tools.description: Discover companies recommended from the companies you follow. Optionally filter by source_company_id (company.id from following.list, not a follow ID). Returns one flat list plus per-source counts. To follow a recommendation, use following.follow with candidate_company.id and your chosen filters.

tools.name: recommendations.get
tools.description: Get one recommended company with sources and persona fit

tools.name: recommendations.dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss a recommended company

tools.name: recommendations.block
tools.description: Dismiss a recommended company and block it from future recommendations

tools.name: recommendations.restore
tools.description: Restore a dismissed or blocked recommendation

tools.name: recommendations.feedback
tools.description: Record recommendation feedback to improve future suggestions. The historical feedback tag "watched" records that a company was followed; it does not create a follow. Use following.follow first. Dismiss/block/restore actions are separate tools.

tools.name: account.agenda
tools.description: Get upcoming interviews and action items

tools.name: integrations.list
tools.description: List connected Google accounts and their grant status. To connect a new account, use integrations.connect_google.

tools.name: integrations.connect_google
tools.description: Get a link for the user to connect Gmail to Refine or approve a missing Gmail permission. Refine selects the permission needed for the connected account. The connection happens in the browser with no Refine sign-in required. Share the link only with the owner of this Refine account.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "jobs.offer.accept" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Accept the offer for a job. This is a major state change that closes out the search for this role; confirm with the user before calling. It does not email the e…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jobs.offer.accept, following.digest.get, companies.submissions.create, openings.add_to_board, search.get, inbox.list, inbox.get, inbox.get_thread, inbox.mark_read, inbox.unsubscribe, inbox.dismiss, inbox.refresh · Private data: jobs.offer.create, inbox.undo, recommendations.feedback · Public sink: jobs.offer.accept, jobs.offer.decline, following.follow, following.digest.get, following.digest.update, companies.submissions.create, openings.add_to_board, inbox.list, inbox.get_thread, inbox.draft_reply, inbox.send_reply, inbox.unsubscribe, inbox.decline, integrations.connect_google · Destructive: jobs.delete, jobs.interviews.delete, jobs.offer.delete, jobs.offer.delete_negotiation, following.unfollow, inbox.undo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jobs.offer.accept, following.digest.get, companies.submissions.create, openings.add_to_board, search.get, inbox.list, inbox.get, inbox.get_thread, inbox.mark_read, inbox.unsubscribe, inbox.dismiss, inbox.refresh · Private data: jobs.offer.create, inbox.undo, recommendations.feedback · Public sink: jobs.offer.accept, jobs.offer.decline, following.follow, following.digest.get, following.digest.update, companies.submissions.create, openings.add_to_board, inbox.list, inbox.get_thread, inbox.draft_reply, inbox.send_reply, inbox.unsubscribe, inbox.decline, integrations.connect_google · Destructive: jobs.delete, jobs.interviews.delete, jobs.offer.delete, jobs.offer.delete_negotiation, following.unfollow, inbox.undo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
